intro: A B2 text to read in one go. Follow the connectors, and notice what triggers each subjunctive.

bloques.titulo: How to read a B2 text
bloques.texto:
Before you look up a word, find the **connectors**. They are the skeleton of the argument.

- **No cabe duda de que**: the writer accepts a fact.
- **Sin embargo**: the turn. Here comes the problem.
- **Además**: one more point on the same side.
- **De ahí que**: the consequence.
- **En definitiva**: the conclusion.

Then look at each **subjunctive** and ask what triggered it: **se quejan de que**, **de ahí que**, **proponen que**, **por** pequeña **que**, **para que**.

Finally, guess unknown words from their parts: **masificado** comes from masa; **convivir** is con + vivir.

bloques.titulo: Festivals: a blessing or a problem?

frases.es: En España se celebran cada año más de mil festivales de música.
frases.en: More than a thousand music festivals are held in Spain every year.
analisis: más de mil festivales de música

frases.es: No cabe duda de que los festivales generan ingresos y puestos de trabajo.
frases.en: There is no doubt that festivals generate income and jobs.

frases.es: Sin embargo, en algunas ciudades los vecinos se quejan de que el centro esté masificado.
frases.en: However, in some cities residents complain that the centre is overcrowded.

frases.es: Los hoteles suben tanto los precios esos días que muchos jóvenes tienen que dormir fuera del casco antiguo.
frases.en: Hotels raise their prices so much on those days that many young people have to sleep outside the old town.

frases.es: Además, el comercio local se llena de gente a medida que se acercan los conciertos.
frases.en: In addition, local shops fill up with people as the concerts get closer.

frases.es: De ahí que varios organizadores hayan decidido limitar el número de entradas.
frases.en: Hence several organisers have decided to limit the number of tickets.

frases.es: Otros proponen que los visitantes paguen una fianza, por pequeña que sea.
frases.en: Others propose that visitors pay a deposit, however small it may be.

frases.es: En definitiva, el reto es encontrar un equilibrio para que visitantes y vecinos puedan convivir.
frases.en: All in all, the challenge is to find a balance so that visitors and residents can live side by side.

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, what is the benefit of festivals?

opciones.They create income and jobs: Generan ingresos y puestos de trabajo.
opciones.They lower prices: The text says prices have gone up.
opciones.They protect local shops: The text says local shops close early.

bloques.pregunta: Why have many young people had to sleep outside the old town?

opciones.Accommodation has pushed prices up: Han subido tanto los precios que…
opciones.There are no beds anywhere: No beds anywhere is not the cause given; the text is about rising prices.
opciones.The sandwich stalls are too noisy: Noisy stalls are not the cause the text gives for sleeping elsewhere.

opciones.To ban visitors from the centre: The text does not go that far.
opciones.To build more stages: The text does not mention stages.

bloques.correcta: To limit the number of tickets

bloques.pregunta: Why is «hayan decidido» in the subjunctive?

opciones.It follows de ahí que: De ahí que always takes the subjunctive.
opciones.It is in the past: The past alone does not call for the subjunctive.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: residents complain that the centre is overcrowded.
bloques.frase: Los vecinos se quejan ___ que el centro esté masificado.

opciones.de: Quejarse takes de: quejarse de que means to complain that something happens.

opciones.explicacion: Por pequeña que sea means however small it may be, a concessive construction.
That would be porque es pequeña.
The phrase is a concession about size.

bloques.frase: El reto es encontrar un equilibrio
bloques.traduccion: The challenge is to find a balance.

bloques.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write an opinion essay on music festivals in cities: benefits, problems and solutions.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Give a three-minute talk for or against limiting the number of tickets at a big festival.
